notes.title: New System, New Game!
notes.notes:
Its finally here!

Escortina Life! rebuilt and this time with a new car mechanism!
The new 1.2.0 version works as usual with the PhysX engine, but now also with our own VeloDy engine. this car mechanism engine was created with C# code surprisingly well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819537/bd9c818223784726f001678bdc4f72f580282a34.png[/img]

VeloDyn is still a work in progress and a work in progress. for example, cars do not have visible tires yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819537/3d91d82fa227748ac79e1fa8c9a0f8231e9130b1.png[/img]

VeloDyn also does not offer sound effects or collision mechanisms for now.

the new Beta 1.2.0 version includes a new test field as well as a new main menu and loading screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819537/57a9a6e367b753fc4b64edb9c3484f383833b05d.png[/img]

the Tord Escort has also been renewed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44819537/0fcbb0960699161ca9c33d59dd6d5d60437138e1.png[/img]

Nuclear Maniacs wishes you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

@NuclearManiacs

notes.title: New beginning?
notes.notes:
Escortina life! a game that got off to a bad start and didn't succeed at all.

Well guess what. The Nuclear Maniacs team has finally started to develop the project into a proper game so that every player can enjoy the world of classic cars.

This means that the idea of ​​the game changes completely, and all references to the My Summer Car game are deleted.

We are very sorry, that we brought disappointment after half a year of waiting.

new beginning development plans:


-Realistic car physics

-Great hdri graphics that support Nvidia settings

-Sandbox mode and endless amount of creativity

-More updates and less problems



We really hope that the new beginning of the game impresses you with what we are capable of!

@NuclearManiacs  
14.3.2024
